watches.name: Geylang Lorong O - Carbon Field Watch
watches.description: On the back of the Geylang Lorong 0 Stealth comes the new version with white markers on the bezel. This one is for the folks who want a light, no-nonsense watch for the daily grind. The #GeylangLorong0 is one of 25 pieces, available in 4 dial colours + a skeleton option and a variety of soft cut-to-length FKM Rubber Strap options Housed in a forged carbon case with lumed bezel markers, this piece is rated to 10-bar and comes with 20mm lugs. The process of manufacturing forged carbon cases comes with a very high failure rate when we are as exacting as we are in standards. Each of these cases comes with an internal steel cage, allowing us to use a screw-down case back and screw-down crown. With forged carbon used as a material, no 2 cases will be exactly the same. Each of the carbon bezels is also machined for markings and filled with a blend of lume compound for a soft green glow. * If you want another colour strap from what is provided as a default, please contact us at info@geylangwatchco.store Facts and figures: Outer Case - Forged Carbon Inner Case - Stainless Steel Bezel - Forged Carbon with machined indices Front Crystal - Sapphire Crystal Crown - Screw-down Crown with additional gaskets Case Back - Screw-down Steel Case Back Strap - FKM Rubber Strap Case Diameter - 39.5mm Case Thickness - 10.5mm Dial - applied indices with C1 lume Hands - faceted with C1 lume Lug Width - 20mm Lug to Lug - 45mm Movement - Adjusted NH35 / NH72 (skeleton model only) with hand-winding and hacking seconds Strap - cut-to-size FKM rubber strap with leaf-spring deployant clasp with micro adjustments (suitable for wrist size 14cm-26cm / 5.5-10 inch) Water Resistance - 10 ATM | 2-year International Mail-In Warranty! | Free International Express Courier Shipping (Insured)! | Proudly Assembled, Checked and Tested in Singapore!

watches.name: APEX - Hybrid Chronograph
watches.description: The APEX - the innermost point of precision, the place where speed, control and strategy meet. In motorsport, the APEX defines the perfect line. The APEX features a Hybrid Mecha-Quartz movement - the precision and convenience of a quartz, with the mechanical look of a sweeping chronograph hand, and that all-too-satisfying flyback. We've gone into the world of tones and textures with this one, bringing the texture of the asphalt to the black or white dial, and the polished silver or matte black crown. As with all Geylang Watch Co releases, this one has been done in a small batch again, limited to just 30 units per colour. Facts and figures: Case - 316L Stainless Steel in polished silver or PVD matte black Crystal - Sapphire Crystal Case Back - Screw-down Numbered Case Back Strap - 2-Tone FKM Rubber Strap Case Diameter - 38mm Overall Thickness - 11.7mm Dial - C1 lume Hands - C1 lume Lug Width - 20mm Lug to Lug - 45mm Strap - 20mm width FKM rubber strap with tang buckle Water Resistance - 10 ATM | 1-year International Mail-In Warranty! | Free International Express Courier Shipping (Insured)! | Proudly Assembled, Checked and Tested in Singapore!

watches.name: Geylang Lorong 2 - Industrial Black Steel
watches.description: This one is for the matte black fans amongst us. The #GeylangLorong2 is one of 25 pieces, available in 4 dial colours + a skeleton option and a soft cut-to-length FKM Rubber Strap. To give the piece more texture, we’ve explored different finishes, but all in PVD black for this expression. This way, the watch plays brilliantly with the light as you go about your day. This is a solid 316L piece pvd coated with varying techniques to give it some texture while maintaining an overall black strength. watches.name: Geylang Lorong 1 - Carbon Mil Sub
watches.description: This one is for the Dive Watch fans amongst us. The #GeylangLorong1 is one of 50 pieces, available in 4 dial colours + a skeleton option and a variety of soft cut-to-length FKM Rubber Strap options. A forged carbon bracelet is also supplied along with the Geylang Lorong 1, featuring a notched endlink to match the case lugs. Housed in a forged carbon case with a 120-click unidirectional rotating steel bezel and carbon insert, this piece is rated to 10-bar and comes with 20mm lugs. The process of manufacturing forged carbon cases comes with a very high failure rate when we are as exacting as we are in standards. Each of these cases comes with an internal steel cage, allowing us to use a screw-down case back and screw-down crown. With forged carbon used as a material, no 2 cases will be exactly the same. To make the case look more uniform, we included an external carbon cover on top of the steel case back. We had a 120-click unidirectional rotating bezel married to the steel case, ensuring a functional timing bezel is included - the very hallmark of dive watches. *If you want another colour strap from what is provided as a default, please contact us at info@geylangwatchco.store Facts and figures: Outer Case - Forged Carbon Inner Case - Stainless Steel Bezel - Forged Carbon with machined indices Front Crystal - Sapphire Crystal Crown - Screw-down Crown with additional gaskets Case Back - Screw-down Steel Case Back Strap - FKM Rubber Strap Bracelet - Forged Carbon Bracelet Case Diameter - 42mm Case Thickness - 12mm Dial - applied indices with C1 lume Hands - faceted with C1 lume Lug Width - 20mm Lug to Lug - 48mm Movement - Adjusted NH35 / NH72 (skeleton model only) with hand-winding and hacking seconds Strap - cut-to-size FKM rubber strap with leaf-spring deployant clasp with micro adjustments (suitable for wrist size 14cm-26cm / 5.5-10 inch) Water Resistance - 10 ATM Bracelet - forged carbon bracelet with push pin links and locking mechanism | 2-year International Mail-In Warranty! | Free International Express Courier Shipping (Insured)! | Proudly Assembled, Checked and Tested in Singapore!
